recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change core source for FHIR-13013; future Provenance.activity vocabulary changes should be handled through a new Security WG tracker rather than by reopening this obsolete DSTU2 subset request.
issue_request: FHIR-13013 asked to replace the broken Provenance.activity value set with a narrower extensible subset focused on activities that create, update, delete, append, nullify, anonymize/de-identify/mask/privacy-mark, or legally authenticate/sign target records.
initial_application: Commit df8241d8ed19f08b12c18f34bf71c7bdbf611ef9 applied GF#13013 by reducing the then-current Provenance activity value set to selected DocumentCompletion, ActCode, and DataOperation concepts and commenting out ActStatus, ObligationPolicy, W3C, and extra activity includes, while also updating Provenance narrative for created/revised/deleted/signed versions.
additional_context: Later Published and Applied decisions on the same artifact changed the current target state: FHIR-19410 removed participation role/function codes; FHIR-22104 and FHIR-23712 adjusted the activity vocabulary; FHIR-32517 made Provenance.activity an example binding and narrowed the value set to representative ISO 21089 lifecycle codes; FHIR-55798 clarified the description; and FHIR-55797 added destroy. FHIR-19410, FHIR-22104, FHIR-23712, and FHIR-32517 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current build-scope source has Provenance active, Provenance.activity example-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/provenance-activity-type, and the value set composed only of representative ISO 21089 lifecycle activity concepts, so reintroducing the FHIR-13013-era extensible v3 subset would conflict with later decisions.
